rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ZPL Engine connects AI clients to the Zero Point Logic Engine API, providing 67 tools across 11 categories: Core, Finance, Gaming, AI/ML, Security, Crypto, Certification, Advanced, Universal, Meta, and AI Eval. Tools perform real-time bias detection, stability scoring, and neutrality analysis (AIN scores). AI Eval tools run prompts through Claude to score response distributions for consistency, sycophancy, refusal balance, language equity, and persona drift. Free tier includes 5,000 tokens/month. Setup via `npx zpl-engine-mcp@latest setup`.
